characterList.description: The Astrobloke himself. Middle-aged man with short brown hair, wearing a grey jacket and a black beanie with 'UK CLOUD MAGNETS' written on it in yellow. Imaging Comet C\2022 E3 (ZTF)
Comet C/2022 E3 was discovered by the ZTF team on May 15th, 2018, and is now one of the most interesting comets to image. The last time this comet was visible was in the Stoneage. Its not back for 50,000 years so if you get a chance to see it don't miss out.

This is the first time for me imaging a comet and really enjoyed it. Lots to learn about processing them but quite happy with the results.
Was a good project using my new CEM26 mount by iOptron
